"Ravens X10" has three of four top prizes left and is about halfway through its run. About half of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

The table below shows the full count for "Ravens X10", with every prize level included.
808.headline: Tickets sold so far

809.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Gold Bar Bingo", about two-thirds are still unsold. The game is in the middle of its run, with five of seven top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

The numbers for "Gold Bar Bingo" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
809.headline: Early stage or late

810.body:
On "In the Green", one $50,000 top prize was claimed over a week ago. That leaves four of the original seven. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

Today's free summary of "In the Green" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
810.headline: Top prize count went down

811.body:
"Extreme Green" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. Of its unclaimed prize money, about three-quarters is in wins under $5,000 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

The numbers for "Extreme Green" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
